movers.text: Victor Wembanyama (30.3 mpg, back) and De'Aaron Fox (29.0, shin) are questionable at SAC on 11/23 (Jared Weiss, The Athletic, via ESPN); Dylan Harper (hip) is out 2-3 weeks.
Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (33.5 mpg, back) is out at IND on 11/23 after missing the 11/22 game at MIA; Caruso, Mara and Jaylin Williams also sat 11/22.

Cameron Boozer (30.8 mpg, ankle) is out at CHA on 11/23 and Jerami Grant (22.1, calf strain) is out with a two-week re-evaluation; Scotty Pippen Jr. (back) is week-to-week.
Charlotte ruled out Grayson Allen (27.2 mpg, concussion) and Grant Williams (22.0, hamstring) vs MEM on 11/23; Dennis Schroder (hamstring) is out, Brandon Miller probable (knee).
